title: ReFiNe latent hierarchy Mirror coordinates
blocker: Official ReFiNe control requires Kaolin/Kaolin-Wisp with CUDA extension and external shape assets; unavailable in current CPU-only container.
hypothesis: A compact hierarchy View coordinate can reduce address/latent bytes over native ReFiNe scene latents while preserving held-out SDF/PSNR quality and recursive query cost.
mirror_coordinate: Scene/shape hierarchy View code over recursive field roles
logical_multiplicity: Multiple logical shapes or radiance fields from one shared recursive field
controls_required: Independent per-shape ReFiNe upper control when practical
success_gate: Not frozen; must be specified against native ReFiNe controls before fresh evaluation.
failure_gate: Not frozen; no model run occurred.
boundaries: This feasibility review is not an SDF, PSNR, storage, or speed result.
